The woman on the right initially leans forward resting her head on her clasped hands.
The woman on the right lifts her head and looks across at the woman on the left.
The woman on the right rests her chin on her hands and expresses feeling overwhelmed by pressure.
The woman on the left continues to counsel and reassure the woman on the right.
high_level_conclusions: The woman on the left is acting as a supportive friend offering advice and comfort.
